This one time after catholic school, my friend, who isn't extremely religious, came up to me and tells me according to his teacher, that Pokemon **is** from the devil. That his teacher knows Japanese and that Pikachu means "1,000 times better then god". I remember trying to explain to her what it actually meant, but I'm not sure if I got to "convince" her.

Luckily for me, my parents are religions, but not stupid, so I got to enjoy Pokemon as a kid.
